canonical_statement: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y of nonsingular quasi-projective varieties over a field and every alpha in K_0(X), ch(f_* alpha) cap td(T_Y) = f_*(ch(alpha) cap td(T_X)) in rational Chow homology of Y.
domain_and_universes: universes u v; k : Type u with Field k; X Y : Scheme.{u}; source and target structure morphisms to Spec k; f : X -> Y; KZero and ChowHomologyQ are Scheme-indexed Type v families with AddCommGroup instances; alpha : KZero X; the target is Prop.
ordered_binders: the eight typed-interface compatibility hypotheses for K_0, rational Chow homology, both pushforwards, Chern character, tangent bundles, Todd classes, and cap action
hypotheses: X and Y are varieties over the same field k
their structure morphisms are smooth, encoding nonsingularity
X and Y are quasi-projective over k
f is a k-morphism and is proper
KZero models K_0 and ChowHomologyQ models rational Chow homology
the two pushforwards, Chern characters, tangent data, Todd classes, and cap actions have their standard meanings
conclusion: For every alpha : D.KZero D.X, the equality D.capY (D.chernCharacterY (D.kTheoryPushforward alpha)) (D.toddClassY D.tangentBundleY) = D.chowPushforward (D.capX (D.chernCharacterX alpha) (D.toddClassX D.tangentBundleX)) holds in D.ChowHomologyQ D.Y.
minimal_import_basis: Morphisms.Proper supplies Scheme, Spec, category composition, IsProper, and the algebraic group substrate used by the typed K_0 and Chow families. Morphisms.Smooth supplies the concrete Smooth predicate for the two structure morphisms. Replacing Proper with its weaker Separated dependency makes IsProper unavailable; replacing Smooth with its weaker RingHomProperties dependency makes Smooth unavailable. The checker runs both negative probes; no aggregate Mathlib import is used.
encoding_boundary: The pinned snapshot has no combined native scheme-level API for quasi-projective varieties, K_0, rational Chow homology, proper pushforwards on those theories, Chern character, tangent bundles, Todd classes, or cap products. GrothendieckRiemannRochData therefore combines actual pinned Scheme, field, smoothness, and properness surfaces with conclusion-free typed families, operations, and named semantic compatibility hypotheses for exactly the missing notions. No field stores, proves, or definitionally implies the GRR equality.
